items.title: 「jubeat」新筐体を「アミューズメント エキスポ 2026」でチェック。120fps対応やタッチパネルなど，18年ぶりの刷新で何が変わった？
items.summary: 2008年の登場から18年。KONAMIの音楽ゲーム「jubeat」に，待望の新筐体が登場した。フルHD・120fps対応のディスプレイをはじめ，タッチパネルや新たな演出機能を搭載し，大幅な進化を遂げている。「アミューズメントエキスポ2026」で展示された実機の特徴を，制作スタッフへの取材を交えて紹介しよう。

zh.title: 在“Amusement Expo 2026”上查看新的“jubeat”外壳。 18年来首次革新，比如支持120fps、触摸屏等，有什么变化？
zh.summary: 自2008年首次亮相以来，已经过去18年了。人们期待已久的KONAMI音乐游戏《jubeat》的新机柜已经到来。它经历了重大演变，包括全高清 120fps 显示屏、触摸面板和新的生产功能。我们来介绍一下“Amusement Expo 2026”中展出的实际机器的特点，以及对制作人员的采访。

en.title: Check out the new “jubeat” casing at “Amusement Expo 2026”. What has changed with the first renovation in 18 years, such as 120fps support and touch panel?
en.summary: 18 years have passed since its debut in 2008. The long-awaited new cabinet for KONAMI's music game "jubeat" has arrived. It has undergone significant evolution, including a full HD 120fps display, a touch panel, and new production functions. Let's introduce the characteristics of the actual machines exhibited at "Amusement Expo 2026", along with interviews with the production staff.

My friends who play games and the anchors I follow on video websites have more or less begun to pay attention to some less "standard" audio games. The more you watch and play, you will always encounter some weirdos, such as "Dandelion Unyielding" which was released in September this year. At first glance, when you first see "Dandelion Unyielding", you can easily regard it as a narrative, "small but beautiful" solo game. The art is small and fresh, the music is soft and soothing, a dandelion seed flies in the wind, and finally falls to the ground on the asphalt road, taking root with a little soil in the gap and growing with difficulty. After landing, what the player has to do is to collect water, sunlight and carbon dioxide, and make the dandelion grow through photosynthesis.

ja.summary: 先週の水曜日、57歳のグレッグ・ゼシュクさんはカナダのブリティッシュ・コロンビア州中部のバビン川でニジマス釣りをしていたところ、BioWare氏死亡のニュースが流れた。ゼシュクは釣りに集中するため携帯電話の電源を切った。その日遅く、ゼシュクさんが川から別荘に戻ると、携帯電話にテキストメッセージが流れ込んでいるのに気づきました。 「10通近くのテキストメッセージを受け取りました」とゼシュクさんは語った。 「携帯電話の電源を入れるとすぐに、誰かが私にお悔やみのメッセージを送ってきたのが見えました。『BioWare に起こったことについて深くお詫び申し上げます』。当時の私の最初の反応は、『BioWare はなくなってしまった!』でした」 グレッグ ゼシュクの最近の写真 1995 年、ゼシュクはレイ ムジカおよびオーガスティン イェと共同で BioWare を設立しました。過去 30 年間にわたり、BioWare は「Baldur's Gate」、「Mass Effect」、「Dragon Age」などの高く評価されたゲームを数多く作成し、ロールプレイングを再定義してきました。

en.title: BioWare co-founder: EA executives have never made games, closing the studio is not an accident
en.summary: Last Wednesday, 57-year-old Greg Zeschuk was fishing for rainbow trout on the Babine River in central British Columbia, Canada, when news of BioWare's death spread. In order to concentrate on fishing, Zeshuk turned off his mobile phone. Later that day, Zeshuk returned to his vacation cabin from the river to find a stream of text messages pouring into his phone. "I received almost 10 text messages," Zeshuk said. "As soon as I turned on my phone, I saw someone sending me a message to express condolences: 'I am deeply sorry for what happened to BioWare.' My first reaction at the time was: 'BioWare is gone!'" A recent photo of Greg Zeshuk In 1995, Zeshuk co-founded BioWare with Ray Muzica and Augustine Ye. Over the past 30 years, BioWare has created many highly regarded games such as "Baldur's Gate", "Mass Effect" and "Dragon Age", and even redefined role-playing.
